MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The powered USB hub fits my history of adding computer ports and adapters because it could help me connect more peripherals, although ten ports may be excessive.",
    "The wired earbuds with a microphone resemble the practical audio use of my previous headset, but that connection alone does not give me a reason to replace it now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The smart speaker and streaming sticks serve voice-assistant and TV entertainment needs that my computer connectivity purchases do not suggest.",
    "My tablet mount purchase does not mean I need a new tablet, and my headset purchase does not imply a need for a portable speaker.",
    "The HDMI cable and memory card are useful accessories, but I have no identified HDMI connection or storage expansion need. My DVI cable purchase does not establish either need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat interest in computer accessories as interest in electronics generally.",
    "They seem to interpret owning an accessory as a reason to buy another related device or replace something I already have."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of network adapters, a USB expansion card, and a display cable point toward solving specific connection and compatibility problems.",
    "My purchases are infrequent and spread over years, so an older purchase is a weak reason to assume I need a replacement or upgrade today."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The USB hub recognizes my practical connectivity interests, but most suggestions assume broader electronics needs that I have not shown."
}
